method: Informed solo touch on the production preview. Each sitting starts with its first intentional input. Automatic view events never extend the clock. All action-free gaps over 30 seconds are conservatively excluded in full, including any thinking time. Closed tabs, diagnostics in separate profiles and recorded comparisons are outside both clocks. The minute categories are estimates assigned at contemporaneous notes.
